mechanism: Betamethasone may increase propafenone metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing propafenone levels, while propafenone may inhibit betamethasone metabolism; additional concern for hypokalemia increasing arrhythmia risk with propafenone.
action: Monitor propafenone efficacy and plasma levels; assess electrolytes regularly, particularly potassium; adjust propafenone dosing if needed based on therapeutic drug monitoring.
